headline: Maritime History and Naval Academy Access Requirements
reservation: Access to the United States Naval Academy grounds requires valid government-issued photo identification for all adults. While the historic district is open public land, specific guided tours of the State House and maritime museums may require advance ticketing. Consult official Navy and State House websites for visiting hours and restricted dates.

days.title: Maritime Roots and City Dock
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from the Annapolis City Dock

stops.name: Ego Alley
stops.detail: Observe the waterway where yachts dock in the heart of the historic district, surrounded by 18th-century architecture.

stops.name: Annapolis Maritime Museum & Park
stops.detail: Learn about the ecology of the Chesapeake Bay and the history of the local oyster industry.

days.driving: Walking suggested; local transfers are limited to short distances.
days.note: The historic center is very walkable, but cobblestones may require sturdy footwear.

days.title: Colonial Governance and Education
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the Maryland State House

stops.name: Maryland State House
stops.detail: Tour the oldest state capitol in continuous legislative use, which briefly served as the nation's capital.

stops.name: United States Naval Academy
stops.detail: Walk the grounds to see the Chapel and the tomb of John Paul Jones, adhering to all security protocols.

days.driving: Walking suggested; allow 15 minutes between major sites.
days.note: Official security screenings are mandatory for entry to the Naval Academy.

days.title: Chesapeake Views and Cross-Bay History
days.start: Suggested: 9:30 AM from Sandy Point State Park

stops.name: Sandy Point State Park
stops.detail: Enjoy views of the Chesapeake Bay Bridge and explore the coastal environment of the Western Shore.

stops.name: William Paca House and Garden
stops.detail: Explore the restored 18th-century mansion and its two-acre wilderness garden in the city center.

days.driving: Allow 45 to 60 minutes; bridge traffic varies significantly by time of day.
days.note: Sandy Point can reach capacity early on summer weekends.

intel.title: Historic District Garages
intel.text: Parking in the historic core is heavily restricted; use the Hillman or Gott's Court garages for longer stays. Avoid residential zones where permits are strictly enforced.

intel.title: Urban Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular and GPS signals are excellent throughout the city and surrounding suburbs. Public Wi-Fi is available near the City Dock area.

intel.title: Suburban Supply Points
intel.text: Fuel stations are abundant on West Street and along the major highways leading toward Washington D.C. and Baltimore. No fuel is available within the immediate historic waterfront.

intel.title: Naval Academy Events
intel.text: Check the Academy calendar for graduation week or football games, as these events lead to extreme congestion and closures. Aim for midweek visits to the State House.

intel.title: Maritime Accessibility
intel.text: Water taxis provide access between Eastport and the City Dock. Many historic buildings have steep stairs, though modern upgrades exist in public facilities.

plan.arrival: Arrive via BWI Airport, secure a rental or transit, and head 30 minutes south to Annapolis for check-in near the waterfront.
plan.vehicle: Compact cars are highly recommended due to narrow historic streets and tight parking garage dimensions.
plan.goldenHour: The City Dock at sunset for views of the harbor and the Spa Creek Bridge.
